vedic_reference.note: Eshanraj is derived from the name of the Hindu deity Ishana, who is one of the five faces of Lord Shiva. Ishana is also known as the lord of the universe, and his name is often used as a reverential title for Shiva. Thus, Eshanraj can be seen as a tribute to the power and majesty of Lord Shiva.
